title: pivot
summary: Pivot table data into a wide grouped summary table.

gpu_support.notes: Pivoting runs on host table variables.

description: `pivot(T, rowvars, colvars, datavar)` groups rows by `rowvars`, expands distinct `colvars` values into output variables, and summarizes `datavar` values into the wide result.
behaviors: The `"Method"` option selects the summary method and defaults to `"sum"`.
Row, column, and data variables use table variable selector semantics.
Output variable names are made valid and unique after combining column-key labels with data variable names.

examples.output: P = wide table with one summary column per Kind value
